hook: 🚗 Tesla India's first sales year: *₹247 crore*, 346 cars
tldr: Tesla's India unit made ₹247.31 crore in FY26, its first year selling cars, and a ₹5.16 crore profit.

beats.what: Tesla India Motors and Energy's revenue jumped nearly 12-fold, per a regulatory filing.
beats.why: FY26 was the first year car sales counted; 346 cars were registered Sep 2025–Mar 2026.
beats.care: Sales are speeding up: 650 already this April–Sept. Expect more Teslas on Hyderabad roads.

viz.l: of revenue from selling cars (₹214.69 cr)

cards.body: Of ₹247.31 crore, ₹214.69 crore came from cars and ₹32.40 crore from services. Profit rose to ₹5.16 crore from ₹55.49 lakh. Tesla put about ₹86 crore into the Indian unit and spent ₹62.54 crore on assets. Monthly sales rose from about 49 cars at launch to about 108.

cards.q: Would you buy a Tesla in India?
How many Teslas were registered in India from Sep 2025 to Mar 2026?
cards.why: 346 vehicles, per the filing reported by IANS; 650 more in Apr–Sep 2026.

learn.t: Revenue is money from sales; profit is what's left after costs. Tesla India's ₹247 crore revenue left ₹5.16 crore profit.

watch: Whether Tesla opens showrooms beyond Mumbai, including Hyderabad.

sources.name: The Hans India (IANS)
sources.title: Tesla India posts Rs 247 crore revenue in first fiscal of vehicle sales (26 Oct)
